title: bug: resolved model config tools and systemInstruction are overwritten

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear, actionable bug report identifying a specific code section where resolved model configuration properties (systemInstruction and tools) are unconditionally overwritten by GeminiChat fields. It includes reproduction steps, code location context, and expected vs actual behavior.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The issue requires a localized logic fix in packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.ts to ensure systemInstruction and tools from resolved model configurations are preserved or merged correctly with chat-level fields, along with unit tests in packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.test.ts.

summary.problem: GeminiChat resolves a GenerateContentConfig from modelConfigService but unconditionally overwrites any resolved systemInstruction and tools properties with the chat instance's local fields.
summary.root_cause: In packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.ts, the config object construction spreads currentGenerateContentConfig and then explicitly assigns systemInstruction: this.systemInstruction and tools: this.tools, discarding model-level config values even when present.
summary.context: Model aliases and configurations resolved via modelConfigService can supply specific systemInstruction and tools settings that should take precedence or be preserved when chat-level fields are default or unconfigured.

steps: In packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.ts, update the GenerateContentConfig construction within sendMessageStreamInternal to preserve systemInstruction from currentGenerateContentConfig when available or when this.systemInstruction is empty.
In packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.ts, update the tools property in GenerateContentConfig construction to preserve or merge tools resolved from currentGenerateContentConfig alongside this.tools.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When modelConfigService resolves a configuration with a systemInstruction or tools, those values should be present in the GenerateContentConfig passed to the content generator rather than being overwritten.
verification_steps: Add unit tests in packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.test.ts verifying that systemInstruction from modelConfigService is preserved in GenerateContentConfig when sending messages.
Add unit tests in packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.test.ts verifying that tools from modelConfigService are retained or merged when present in resolved config.
Verify that chat-level systemInstruction and tools are still applied correctly when model config does not define them.
